text_block_list.text:
Taking on the turf route. Furioso and I 
decided to first do a light test of her 
aptitude.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haa!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's not bad. I feel like I can manage 
fairly well once I get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The only problem is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The question is whether, once accustomed, 
one can truly "compete with the top tier."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To verify that, she would have to run 
against an Umamusume currently active on 
turf, but...

It made complete sense. But her peers on 
the turf track were currently giving 
everything they had for the spring G1s.

It doesn't seem like getting a helping 
hand will be that easy, though...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? An opponent for a mock race...? 
Against an Umamusume who wants to try turf 
now...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I really don't have the 
bandwidth for that... Besides, we've 
already set our sights on the Tulip Sho in 
March.

Deciding that her peers were definitely 
out of the question, she thought about 
approaching strong rivals from the 
generation above, but—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A mock race? Of course I accept! I have 
your permission to completely pulverize 
them, right!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why ever not~?! It's not as if I would 
hold back in the slightest, after all!

I tried to call out to the Tiara Double 
Crown Umamusume, Kawakami Princess, but 
she's just way too ferocious...

If the skill gap is too wide, it won't 
serve as a benchmark. We really need to 
find a way to borrow the strength of a top 
contender from her generation, but...

Huh, challenging turf after starting on 
dirt? That's pretty reckless.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Still, I don't hate that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Furioso-senpai is searching for 
someone to race on turf with. If you're 
serious and dreaming big, then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't mind taking you on myself!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san... Yes, please do.

Vodka is among the strongest turf runners 
of her generation. She's an impeccable 
opponent. I decided to ask her to spar 
with us.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hup!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —!? What's with this smooth start!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? This was just the 
run-up. The real deal starts now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oraaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is— the speed of the turf division's 
elite...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-senpai, show me how serious you 
are. Show me what it is you want to 
achieve by running in turf races.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you've got a dream as big as mine, this 
is gonna be one hell of a match! Hryaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What I want to achieve... in a turf 
race...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I...! I will win on the turf, make 
Funabashi's name famous, and—!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: And... And...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Keep running? Just like that... on the 
Central turf?)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oryaaah--!!

—Game, set, match. No, to be precise, it 
wasn't even a contest.

"Furioso couldn't keep up with Vodka at 
all—one of the leading figures of the 
Tiara route."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... No matter how much 
running I do from now on...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I probably can't run like Vodka-san. As 
expected, I just...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like I'm very suited for 
it. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Do you... really, truly want to run on 
turf?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I guess that part just didn't really click 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Unless you've got something you truly, 
desperately want to seize, you can't run 
beyond your aptitudes. ...Do you have one? 
Something you want to seize on the turf?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What I want to grasp on the turf... I...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What I truly want to grasp is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Spring in Funabashi"... Right now, I keep 
losing to the JRA, but one day I'll show 
them—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to draw people to Funabashi. To 
show that we can do it too, so Funabashi 
can stand toe-to-toe with the JRA...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I see, thinking about it like that...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even if I succeed on turf, I likely won't 
be able to pave a path for those who 
follow...

My thoughts were sorted out. The attention 
the turf gets is certainly appealing, 
but...

That was not what we were aiming for. It 
was only natural that there was no soul in 
our running.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My dream wasn't on the turf. But for you, 
Vodka... it's different, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"She wants to win the spring Tiara route 
GⅠs—the Oka Sho and Yushun Himba—no matter 
what. That is why she runs with such 
passion..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, from the 'Oka Sho' to the 'Yushun 
Himba' (Japanese Oaks), huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That's not it. I'm not having that kind 
of dream."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't dream ordinary dreams like 
that. My dream is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"A feat no one has ever achieved. Starting 
from the Oka Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Conquered the Japan Derby! How about 
that?! Totally epic, right?!
choice_data_list: From the Oka Sho to the Japanese Derby?!

text_block_list.text:
In recent years, not a single Umamusume 
has conquered the pinnacle of the Classic 
stage, the Japanese Derby, with such a 
rotation...
choice_data_list:
To commit such a brazen violation of the 
rules...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Breaking the rules? So what? Somethin' 
like that ain't gonna stop me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll pull off a shocker by winning the 
Derby, and make 'em all say, "There's 
never been a cooler Umamusume"! I'm gonna 
become a legend!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Something you can do just by aiming for it 
is merely a target. A dream is called a 
dream precisely because you can't reach it 
just by trying.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Being reckless is just about right. If 
you're not that fired up, it ain't even 
worth chasing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
See ya, farewell. Catch you somewhere down 
the road.
Vodka turned her back and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san... is so cool...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that I was swayed, okay? I 
really wasn't, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the path I chose... will 
what I truly want be waiting...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Without that, a runner's spirit won't 
dwell in their stride, will it?"

A brief detour. Yet it is not in vain, but 
rather a way to confirm the true path.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us aim for it once more. The 
"Japan Dirt Derby"!

I take a moment to refocus on our original 
goal. Just then, from far away—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Nailed it completely!! Man, I 
look so cooool!

...From somewhere, I heard an inadvertent 
cry from the heart.
